commit_message: Renderer: generate missing MikkTSpace tangents centrally
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. The format-neutral model builder preserves authored tangents and generates MikkTSpace-compatible tangent frames only when source tangents are absent. Invalid/non-triangle geometry leaves tangents absent so the renderer's derivative TBN fallback remains active. The dependency and lockfile change intentionally requires full workspace Windows validation.
